title: Write 10 · 影 动 视 脑 班 饭 几 见 手 非 常 叫 请 钱 本
focus: 影 动 视 脑 班 饭 几 见 手 非 常 叫 请 钱 本
body:
Repeating parts: 见 see (视, 见), 讠 (请), 口 (叫, 常), 王 (班), 月 flesh (脑), 云 (动).

## Rules that matter here
- **Left half before right half**: 非, 影, 班.
- **礻 vs 衤**: 视 has one dot (spirit/show), clothing 衤 has two.
- 几 vs 儿: 几 is joined at the top.

cards.Notes: 景 scene (12: 日 + 京, phonetic jǐng) + 彡 hair strokes (3) = 15 strokes. Left part fully first, then three ノ on the right.
云 cloud (4) + 力 strength (2) = 6 strokes. Left before right; 力: 横折钩, then ノ. Lookalike: 运 (云 + 辶).
礻 spirit/show (4) + 见 see (4) = 8 strokes. Watch: 礻 (one dot) not 衤 (two dots, clothing).
月 flesh (4) + right part (6: 亠, 㐅, 凵) = 10 strokes. Left before right; 凵 last. Lookalike: 恼 (忄).

cards.Prompt: 上＿ · shàngbān · to go to work
cards.Notes: 王 + dot and ノ + 王 = 10 strokes. Left to right: two jades split by a knife-like middle. Left 王 ends with a rising stroke.
饣 food (3) + 反 (4, phonetic fǎn) = 7 strokes. Left before right. Lookalikes: 板 (木), 版.
2 strokes: ノ, then 横折弯钩 (乙-like). Lookalike: 儿 (two separate strokes, open top).
4 strokes: 丨, 横折, ノ, then 竖弯钩 last. Pictured as an eye on legs. Lookalike: 贝 (dot instead of hook).
4 strokes: ノ, 一, 一, then the vertical hook 亅 through them. Lookalike: 毛 (hook turns right).
8 strokes: left vertical, then its three horizontals (last one rising); then right vertical and its three horizontals. Left side before right side.
⺌ (3) + 冖 (2) + 口 (3) + 巾 cloth (3) = 11 strokes. Top to bottom. Lookalike: 堂 (土 at bottom).

cards.Prompt: 你＿什么名字？ · nǐ jiào shénme míngzi · what's your name?
cards.Notes: 口 mouth (3) + 丩 (2, phonetic jiū) = 5 strokes. Left before right; the long vertical last.

cards.Prompt: ＿问 · qǐngwèn · excuse me, may I ask
cards.Notes: 讠 speech (2) + 青 blue-green (8, phonetic qīng) = 10 strokes. Lookalikes: 清 (氵), 情 (忄), 晴 (日).

cards.Prompt: 多少＿ · duōshao qián · how much money
cards.Notes: 钅 metal (5) + 戋 (5, phonetic) = 10 strokes. 戋: two 一, 斜钩, ノ, dot last. Lookalike: 浅 (氵).
木 tree (4) + short 一 at the root (1) = 5 strokes. Write 木 first, the short bottom line last. A mark at the root of a tree.
